title: Workspace Missing - Customer Reports Data Loss with No Backup
agent_context: Customer reports a missing workspace/data loss with high business impact and no backup. Treat as high-severity: show ownership, collect minimal key details, start audit/recovery investigation, escalate to engineering, and set clear update cadence without promising recovery.

raw_content.initial_message: I logged in this morning and one of our main workspaces is just gone...
raw_content.context: Customer reports missing workspace/data. Root cause unknown. Policy: do not blame; do not promise recovery; collect details; initiate audit logs + recovery check; escalate; set cadence.

learning_objectives: Respond empathetically to high-impact data loss
correct_sop_steps: Clarify workspace scope + last seen time

sticky_notes: HINT: Ask last seen timestamp + admin actions.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Calms down when investigation starts + cadence set
